question: Among cards illustrated by Allen Williams that are legal in the Commander format, what percentage have unknown power (either NULL or '*')? Return the artist name and this percentage rounded to two decimal places.

SELECT 
    c.XCL_002 AS artist_name,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_003 IS NULL OR c.XCL_003 = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) AS percentage_unknown_power
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Allen Williams'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Commander'
  AND l.XCL_084 = 'Legal'
GROUP BY c.XCL_002
